Discounts do seem to drive real extra spending, not just bigger carts: even comparing orders with the same number of items, discounted orders are worth 13-117% more than non-discounted ones.

Our 'free subscription box for lapsed customers' leak is bigger than last week's number: €22.3k confirmed at 6 merchants, but 6 more merchants running the same program were never counted before — one alone is bigger than all 6 known ones combined. We're not using last week's ~€57k figure until this is re-counted properly.

A refund pattern we flagged last week turned out to be normal, not abuse: our 'Welcome10' discount's high refund total is mostly explained by that merchant's already-high ~37% apparel return rate, not coupon gaming.
